userStories.title: Fable/rung-scoped CLI is RateLimit with narrow 3600s Wait, not crash or Blackout
userStories.description: PR-1 / FR-002 / US-002. Live CLI `You've reached your Fable limit. … switch models with /model.` matches neither `hit your` nor `usage limit`, so is_rate_limited misses it and the iteration classifies as a crash (auto-block). After classification, decide_account_rate_limit still prefers api_secs (session ~5h or weekly ~6d), spillover records a provider Blackout, unknown-reset falls through to usage_fallback_wait 300s, and react_to_outputs always wires usage_gate + probe_rate_limit_lifted (30s CLI probe with no -m lifts the wait). Coordinator contract: widen detection enough for the live sentence; key the 3600 Wait override on a NARROW predicate (model token fable|opus|sonnet|haiku followed by `limit`, OR co-occurrence with `switch models`). `/model` alone is not sufficient. Plain `reached your … limit` is ordinary RateLimit and keeps api_secs. Independently shippable. No auto-downgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: (a) is_rate_limited is true for the live sentence `You've reached your Fable limit`; analyze_output classifies it as IterationOutcome::RateLimit (not Crash). Consecutive-failure / auto-block do not increment (RateLimit already excluded at both handle_task_failure callers)

3600 Wait override keys on a narrow Fable/rung-scoped predicate: a model token (`fable|opus|sonnet|haiku`) followed by `limit`, OR co-occurrence with `switch models`. `/model` alone is NOT sufficient. Non-Fable fixture: `You've reached your Opus limit` → Wait { 3600 } (override must not be `contains("fable")` only)
(f) Plain `You've reached your session limit` / `reached your … limit` (no model token, no `switch models`) is ordinary RateLimit: keep api_secs; spillover may Blackout

(b) decide_account_rate_limit with api_secs = 6 days + Fable output returns Wait { secs: blackout_fallback_secs } (default 3600), ignoring api_secs and output_secs. Not Blackout. Not ~6 days. Not session 5h. Not usage_fallback_wait 300s. Test (b) requires api_secs populated — `api_secs=None` is not sufficient

(c) spillover_enabled = true + Fable phrasing → still Wait, blackout map empty (no RateLimitAction::Blackout, no provider_blackouts.record). Spillover is never a working rung for rung-scoped decisions

(d) react_to_outputs / react_to_outputs_with_io_seams must NOT invoke usage_gate or probe_rate_limit_lifted for that phrasing; sleep is stop-signal-aware only (IoSeamSpy: usage_gate_calls=0, probe not wired). Otherwise used 55% < 92 returns BelowThreshold or the 30s no -m probe lifts

Do NOT add dated `Sep 12` / month-name parsing in PR-1. Keep parse_reset_from_output returning None for `sep` tokens (e.g. `resets Sep 12, 12:59am`). Fable 3600 comes from the phrasing override, not from parsing a weekly reset out of the CLI text
(e) Negative: `You've hit your limit · resets 4pm` still uses output_secs / may Blackout (account copy must not take the 3600 override)

(g) Wave: one Fable RateLimit + two completions → exactly one 3600s wait, no provider_blackouts.record (WaitSpy.calls==1, last_secs==3600, blackout.active empty). Seq and wave share react_to_outputs_inner
(h) output containing only `/model` (no model token, no `switch models`, no `limit`) does not take the 3600 override; if classified RateLimit at all, keep api_secs / may Blackout

Docs: PR-1 pin is required for parallel/wave (one Fable RateLimit sleeps the whole wave 3600s), not recommended. Recipe: `task-mgr models set-tier claude frontier <standard-model>` until PR-3. Sequential without the pin: that task waits 3600s (accepted, no auto-downgrade). Record in src/loop_engine/CLAUDE.md account-global section; one-liner in CLAUDE.md models/workflow if a pin recipe fits
userStories.notes: Two predicates, do not collapse: (1) is_rate_limited classification may widen to catch `You've reached your Fable limit` (and may also classify plain `You've reached your session limit` as RateLimit — that is OK). (2) the 3600 Wait override is NARROWER — model token + limit OR `switch models`; not `/model` alone (test h); not every RateLimit; not plain reached-your-limit. Non-Fable fixture `You've reached your Opus limit` → Wait 3600 so the override is not contains("fable") only. Implement the override in decide_account_rate_limit AND skip usage_gate/probe in react_to_outputs_with_io_seams when the narrow predicate matches (the skip cannot live only in the inner — the production wait closure always loads api_secs and wires the probe today). Use blackout_fallback_secs even when spillover is off; do not use fallback_wait 300. Exhaustive AccountReactionParams destructure must still compile (parity lock). Tests belong next to existing decide_* unit tests in account.rs and IoSeamSpy / WaitSpy cases in tests/reaction_parity.rs. Learning [5090]: malformed quota messages fall back — do not add Sep 12 parse to paper over None. Learning [5297]/[5298]/[5301]: dual predicate unchanged except this Fable-phrasing skip of BOTH usage_gate AND probe. Learning [5075]/[4866]/[4171]/[4151]: account-global once per wave. Learning [5088]/[3927]: must not fall through handle_quota_deferral; never provider_blackouts.record on this phrasing. Learning [4126]/[4182]: seq+wave share the coordinator. Known-bad: matching `/model` alone; using api_secs when Fable matches; Blackout when spillover on; still wiring probe; contains("fable") only.
